headline: Presidential order aimed at making the U.S. electric grid more reliable and secure.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed April 8, 2025, deals with the reliability and security of the nation's electric grid. Based on its title, it directs federal action meant to keep the power supply steady and protect it from threats. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and deadlines involved are not described here.
